whyDescription: Student Tribe built the network — 1M+ students, 500+ campuses, a decade of hiring relationships. St.School exists to funnel that network into a small, mentor-dense cohort instead of a mass-market course.
processDescription: The same process runs for every cohort, every program. It's designed to keep the bar high and the attention per student even higher.
